candidates.title: Daily sales by product (till system)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source of daily units_sold and revenue_eur per product_code; catalog temporal coverage starts 2022-01-01 with open end, daily refresh (last 2026-10-14), so it spans both windows on paper.
candidates.found_via: search 'daily sales ice cream product' and 'POS transactions gelato by day'; get_catalog_entry; wiki till_migration_2024
suspected_issues: Wiki till_migration_2024 (last edited 2024-03-12): till replaced 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10, no sales recorded, no rows in the table for those days; must be treated as missing, not zero.
Wiki product_codes_2024 (last edited 2024-04-02): codes ending in 'L' replaced from 2024-04-01; no mapping table exists; match only by product name, names not unique.
Catalog gives no info on whether units_sold/revenue include voids or refunds; grain is product-day, so closed days are not flagged in this table (must join store.calendar).
Classification confidential; access via request to Retail Operations (warehouse SQL). No licence/consent recorded beyond internal use.
Approx 310,000 rows; no info on whether the recent-window extract comes from the same system.

candidates.title: Product list (current codes, names, categories)
candidates.why_relevant: Only product-name source for matching old 'L' codes to new codes; needed to build a manual name-based crosswalk.
candidates.found_via: search 'product code change 2024 mapping'; get_catalog_entry; wiki product_codes_2024
suspected_issues: Holds only CURRENT codes (wiki product_codes_2024), so old codes from the history window are not present here.
Last refreshed 2025-03-31 while the recent window runs to 2026-03-31; product list may be stale for recent months.
About 64 rows; wiki says no mapping table exists, so the crosswalk would have to be built and owner-validated.

candidates.title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, local events)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal record of is_open per day, needed to separate closed days from zero-sales days and to check the till-migration gap; event_name is the only internal events field.
candidates.found_via: search 'opening hours shop calendar closures...', 'local events eventi comune calendar', 'holiday calendar Italy festivi'; get_catalog_entry
suspected_issues: No wiki backlinks: no documentation page describes this calendar's maintenance or accuracy.
Refresh is weekly (last 2026-10-10); steward Elena Russo, Store Operations.
event_name has no start/end or source fields; event list likely incomplete (no evidence either way in catalog).
Catalog has no location field, so it cannot confirm which city/branch it covers (Valdena branch list not found).

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Registered daily-weather source for N3; can request temperature_2m_max for an Italian location over 2023-06-01 to 2026-03-31.
suspected_issues: Register default coordinates are Lisbon (38.72, -9.14) and default timezone UTC: both must be replaced (coordinates for an assumed Italian city recorded in decisions.md; timezone Europe/Rome).
Reanalysis smooths extremes compared with station observations (limitation to note).
Recent-window availability to 2026-03-31 not verified in the register.

candidates.title: Nager.Date public holidays API (country IT)
candidates.why_relevant: Registered source of national Italian public holidays per year; covers 2023-2026 if called per year.
suspected_issues: Register states national holidays only; regional/patron days for the chosen city are not covered and need a separate source.
Holidays on Sundays need flagging to avoid double counting.
Register does not confirm Ferragosto or Easter Monday treatment, or whether the shop closes on them; no official Italian source (Gazzetta Ufficiale) linked in register.

unmet_needs: N2: No mapping table exists (wiki product_codes_2024); no internal crosswalk of old 'L' codes to new codes. Only name-based matching is possible, and names are not unique. Needs the Retail Operations owner to confirm a mapping, or a manual crosswalk built with them. Not a link-supplied dataset.
N3 location: no source names the shop city or branch; catalog and wiki have no coordinates. A city must be chosen and recorded as an assumption in decisions.md before the Open-Meteo pull.
N4 regional/patron holidays for the chosen city: not in Nager.Date; needs a regional or statistics source (human-supplied link) if used.
N5 local events: no internal events log beyond event_name in store.calendar; a comune open-data events calendar for the chosen city would need a human-supplied link and is likely incomplete/undated.

Sales licence/consent: internal confidential table with access by request; no agreement recorded for the till data beyond internal use. Owner approval of the recent-window extract and product list not found.
